query:
SELECT 'anna_appcast_meetings' as check_name, COUNT(*) as count
FROM meetings m
LEFT JOIN sponsors s ON m.sponsorId = s.id
WHERE m.attendeeId = '195183358360' AND s.companyName LIKE '%Appcast%'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'total_meetings', COUNT(*) FROM meetings
UNION ALL
SELECT 'repeat_meetings', COUNT(*) FROM (
  SELECT attendeeId, sponsorId, COUNT(*) as cnt
  FROM meetings
  GROUP BY attendeeId, sponsorId
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
) x;
